001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.otlp;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Map;
005import java.util.function.Consumer;
006
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.ConvertParameter;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.ExtendedFieldPrefix;
017
018/**
019 * Encodes each event as one line of OTLP/JSON: a complete {@code LogsData} object holding
020 * a single log record. This is the OpenTelemetry file format, read by the OpenTelemetry
021 * Collector's {@code otlpjsonfile} receiver or by the {@code filelog} receiver with the
022 * {@code otlpjson} connector, so it needs no network connection.
023 * <p>
024 * Each record carries the formatted message as its body, the logger name as its
025 * instrumentation scope, {@code thread.name}, {@code thread.id}, the key values selected
026 * by {@code keyValuesIncluded} and {@code keyValuesExcluded} (all by default), and for a
027 * throwable {@code exception.type}, {@code exception.message}, and
028 * {@code exception.stacktrace} attributes. When the event has caller info it also carries
029 * {@code code.function.name}, {@code code.file.path}, and {@code code.line.number}. Event
030 * thread, caller, and exception attributes take precedence over key values with the same
031 * names. Key values named by {@code traceIdKey} and {@code spanIdKey} (default
032 * {@code traceId} and {@code spanId}, as Micrometer Tracing puts them in the MDC) become
033 * the record's trace context when they are valid W3C ids, and the key value
034 * {@code otel.event.name} becomes the record's event name.
035 * <p>
036 * The include and exclude lists are case sensitive globs where {@code *} matches any
037 * characters and {@code ?} matches one character. An excluded key is never added.
038 */
039public final class OtlpJsonEncoder extends LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer> {
040
041        /**
042         * Encoder URI scheme.
043         */
044        public static final String OTLP_SCHEME = "otlp";
045
046        /**
047         * Default key value name holding the trace id.
048         */
049        public static final String DEFAULT_TRACE_ID_KEY = "traceId";
050
051        /**
052         * Default key value name holding the span id.
053         */
054        public static final String DEFAULT_SPAN_ID_KEY = "spanId";
055
056        private final OtlpResource resource;
057
058        private final OtlpRecord.Mapping mapping;
059
060        OtlpJsonEncoder(OtlpResource resource, OtlpRecord.Mapping mapping) {
061                this.resource = resource;
062                this.mapping = mapping;
063        }
064
065        /**
066         * Creates the encoder with a builder lambda; properties are applied after the lambda.
067         * @param consumer configures the builder.
068         * @return encoder provider.
069         */
070        public static LogProvider<OtlpJsonEncoder> of(Consumer<OtlpJsonEncoderBuilder> consumer) {
071                return (s, c) -> {
072                        var b = new OtlpJsonEncoderBuilder(s);
073                        consumer.accept(b);
074                        return b.fromProperties(c.properties()).build();
075                };
076        }
077
078        /**
079         * Creates the encoder.
080         * @param name property name prefix.
081         * @param serviceName {@code service.name} resource attribute, default
082         * {@code unknown_service:java}.
083         * @param resourceAttributes additional resource attributes.
084         * @param traceIdKey key value holding the trace id, default {@code traceId}.
085         * @param spanIdKey key value holding the span id, default {@code spanId}.
086         * @param keyValuesIncluded globs of key values to add as attributes, default all.
087         * @param keyValuesExcluded globs of key values not to add as attributes.
088         * @param environmentVariables whether {@code OTEL_SERVICE_NAME} and
089         * {@code OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES} are read, default off.
090         * @return encoder.
091         */
092        @LogConfigurable(name = "OtlpJsonEncoderBuilder", prefix = LogProperties.ENCODER_PREFIX + "otlp.")
093        static OtlpJsonEncoder of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable String serviceName,
094                        @Nullable Map<String, String> resourceAttributes, @Nullable String traceIdKey, @Nullable String spanIdKey,
095                        @Nullable List<String> keyValuesIncluded, @Nullable List<String> keyValuesExcluded,
096                        @ConvertParameter("parseEnvironmentVariables") @Nullable EnvironmentVariables environmentVariables) {
097                var env = environmentVariables == null ? EnvironmentVariables.OFF : environmentVariables;
098                return new OtlpJsonEncoder(OtlpResource.of(serviceName, resourceAttributes, env),
099                                OtlpRecord.Mapping.of(traceIdKey, spanIdKey, keyValuesIncluded, keyValuesExcluded));
100        }
101
102        static EnvironmentVariables parseEnvironmentVariables(String value) {
103                return EnvironmentVariables.parse(value);
104        }
105
106        @Override
107        protected JsonBuffer doBuffer(BufferHints hints) {
108                return new JsonBuffer(false, ExtendedFieldPrefix.AT, -1);
109        }
110
111        @Override
112        protected void doEncode(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer) {
113                buffer.clear();
114                OtlpJson.write(buffer, resource, List.of(OtlpRecord.of(event, mapping)));
115                buffer.writeLineFeed();
116        }
117
118}
